idea-plugin.name: Xonsh
idea-plugin.description:
Xonsh shell script support:
  • Syntax highlighting
  • Code completion
  • Inspections / diagnostics
  • Documentation on hover, and other useful info such as env var values
  • Go To Declaration, Show/Find Usages
  • and more

Most features are provided by xonsh-language-server via LSP4IJ. The plugin includes a TextMate grammar for syntax highlighting outside LSP scope.

xonsh-lsp is run with uvx or pipx by default. If installed manually, either put it on your PATH or specify a custom command in Language Server settings. xonsh-lsp supports several Python backends, including Jedi (built-in), Pyright, and python-lsp-server (pylsp).

Known issue: if *.xsh / *.xonshrc files are registered as Python in your IDE (which PyCharm may suggest), the plugin will not work on them. To fix it, go to Settings → Editor → File Types → Python and remove xsh extensions, then restart the IDE.
